# Blushlab

> Blushlab combines a makeup studio and a My Face mode in one game for iOS and Android, now in development. Try shadow, liner, lashes, blush, lip, brows and lenses on a face, or on your own photo.

Blushlab is a casual makeup game by ipe() (https://ipe.rest/). It is in development for iOS and Android and has NOT been released: no store page or release date exists yet. This site is the game's home and its journal.

## Key facts

- Makeup Studio: try shadow, liner, lashes, blush, lip, brows and lenses on a character.
- My Face: use the same tools on your own photo. Photos are processed only on your device and are not sent to a server.
- Free to start; in-app purchases are available. No ads.

## Privacy

- The Blushlab app does not send photos to a server.
- This website collects only basic visit statistics through Google Analytics and has no ads; see the privacy policy.

## Pages

- [Home](https://blushlab.ipe.rest/): Makeup Studio uses face-makeup tools. My Face uses your own photo, processed on your device. Free to start, no ads.
- [About](https://blushlab.ipe.rest/about/): what Blushlab is and who makes it
- [Support](https://blushlab.ipe.rest/support/): contact and questions
- [Privacy Policy](https://blushlab.ipe.rest/privacy/)
- [Terms of Use](https://blushlab.ipe.rest/terms/)
- [Journal](https://blushlab.ipe.rest/journal/): notes from the making of the app
- [RSS](https://blushlab.ipe.rest/journal/feed.xml)
